assessment: This is a valuable study of Arabidopsis shoot apical meristem maintenance and organ initiation, with a focus on how SHR, SCR, JKD, and SCL23, four transcription factors initially characterized in root meristems, are deployed in a different context. The imaging, genetics and FRET-FLIM evidence supporting the claims of the authors is compelling. The work will be of interest and importance for plant developmental biologists.
